chaos-chant.intent: Turn uncontrolled movement into performed expertise.
chaos-chant.cadence: Breathless rhythmic propulsion with legible repeated words.

false-triumph-button.intent: Rebrand visible failure as victory and demand the listener accept it.
false-triumph-button.cadence: Clean, compact authority after the body has failed; the held contrast is the joke.
auditFocus: line is shorter than the silence around it

deadpan-affection.intent: Name the truth without withdrawing affection.
deadpan-affection.cadence: Still, exact and dry; warmth appears only at the exit.
auditFocus: no broad smile in the voice

quiet-warning.intent: Make the listener notice danger without manufacturing panic.
quiet-warning.cadence: Measured and grounded with one operative warning word.

held-heart.intent: Let the listener receive a truth the speaker can no longer hide.
held-heart.cadence: Breath-led sincerity; silence is motivated and the exit differs from the entry.
